notes.title: The new map is coming SOON!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone! It's that time of the year again and I've come with some exciting news to share!
You may remember last year the new map was teased with the caption [i][b]"Everyone starts from somewhere small, even Amber Lee..."[/b][/i]. After a year of waiting, the new map will finally be coming this month! It may be a little after Christmas, just because I'm really busy at the moment (Sorry, I'm graduating COLLEGE in literally 2 days haha). But I've got the whole thing planned out and so far its turning out really good!

[h2]So... what is it?[/h2]
I'm happy to announce the new map is [b]The Library[/b]! I bet you didn't see that one coming! The teaser was a bit of a misnomer, but it'll make sense when you play the map...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795525/7a946ea8e2fdda10b955d2a997b98a4c166a9d00.png[/img]
[wip image]

In this map, you'll have to nagivate around tight bookshelves as Amber Lee hunts you down. It will surely be the night of your life as you knock down bookshelves, hack into computers, and more! You better stay quiet though... even though the library is closed, the [b]Robot Librarian[/b] sure doesn't appreciate your mischief!

[h2]The Librarian[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795525/bad998c2dadccf50e6e22ccd8ac8af437a05961a.png[/img]
A rule-follower, right down to the core. She's up late working the nightshift and she certianly doesn't appreciate your noise. She acts as a neutral threat, adding extra challenge and mechanics to the already spooky night. If you're too loud, she may just throw you out! Will you and the robot team up to defeat Amber's loud screaming, or will Amber and the robot team up to put a stop to your loud creaking... I'm super proud of her so far and I think she'll be a ton of fun!

[h2]Release Date[/h2]
As mentioned, these next few weeks are a bit intense for me (graduation and holidays and stuff...) but the map is definently going to be released by the end of the month. I have 4/12 endings completed already and all of the main mechanics are done. It's probably going to be released after Christmas, but I'll keep you posted!

Also, if I have extra time I may release a rework of some of the older maps (2.0 if you will, haha) and polish some issues and make them even better! I may even release the new map, then the updates later, idk.

Anyways, I hope you all have some happy holidays! See you soon :)
